name: letta-job
title: Letta Job
description: Flat structure summary of the Letta Job entity, derived from the Letta OpenAPI 1.0.0 spec.

fields.name: created_by_id
fields.description: The id of the user that made this object.

fields.name: last_updated_by_id
fields.description: The id of the user that made this object.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: The unix timestamp of when the job was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: The timestamp when the object was last updated.

fields.name: completed_at
fields.description: The unix timestamp of when the job was completed.

fields.name: stop_reason
fields.description: The reason why the job was stopped.

fields.name: background
fields.description: Whether the job was created in background mode.

fields.name: agent_id
fields.description: The agent associated with this job/run.

fields.name: callback_url
fields.description: If set, POST to this URL when the job completes.

fields.name: callback_sent_at
fields.description: Timestamp when the callback was last attempted.

fields.name: callback_status_code
fields.description: HTTP status code returned by the callback endpoint.

fields.name: callback_error
fields.description: Optional error message from attempting to POST the callback endpoint.

fields.name: ttft_ns
fields.description: Time to first token for a run in nanoseconds

fields.name: id
fields.description: The human-friendly ID of the Job
